description: Directive inondation, Enjeux liés aux stations de traitements des eaux usées du TRI de l'île de Cayenne, 2015 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto.geoguyane.fr. This dataset gives the spot location of wastewater treatment plants considered to be at stake in the IRR of Cayenne Island. Data sets produced by the GIS Flooding Directive at significant risk of flooding (TRI) of the island of Cayenne and mapping for reporting purposes for the European Flood Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Flood Directive, Issues related to wastewater treatment plants of the IRR of Cayenne Island, 2015" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2015-12-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
